prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [val2] 政务服务 · 办理时限 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "事项名称" spans 1 col × 2 row; "办理时限（工作日）" spans 2 col × 1 row; "所需材料" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "事项名称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 92px
  col 2: header "办理时限（工作日） › 法定" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 3: header "办理时限（工作日） › 承诺" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 4: header "所需材料" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 414px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较不同政务服务事项的法定与承诺办理时限，并查看各事项所需材料。","reading":"读者先按事项名称定位整行，再横向比较两种时限并查看材料；也可能纵向扫描时限列。材料较长，通常决定行高，可容纳同一行事项名称的适度换行。","groups":["第2、3列分别是法定和承诺工作日，属于同一组，作用相同，宜采用相同宽度以便比较。","第1列与第4列分别标识事项和列出材料，通过整行对应关联。"],"keep_intact":["工作日数字及其与对应事项的行关联","事项名称和材料名称应保持可辨识，避免过窄导致逐字换行","法定与承诺两列的表头应清晰对应各自数值"],"may_wrap":["事项名称可在自然位置换行","所需材料可在材料之间及中文自然断行处换行","合并表头“办理时限（工作日）”可按可用空间换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [89, 48, 48, 174] · table 360×345px · row heights [83, 60, 83, 83, 36] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [83, 48, 48, 180] · table 360×345px · row heights [83, 60, 83, 83, 36] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [107, 45, 45, 162] · table 360×345px · row heights [83, 60, 83, 83, 36] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"事项名称与材料都有足够空间分行，三条数据的数字容易横向对应；两种时限等宽，便于纵向比较。材料列比事项列宽，符合内容长度的差异。","problems":"“法定”和“承诺”都竖向拆成两行，合并表头也分成三行，表头显得拥挤而高。材料中的“章程”和“复印件”跨行，影响词语的连续阅读。","cause":"第2、3列各48px，扣除内边距和边框后只有27px，容不下两个15px汉字；两列合计96px也限制了合并表头。材料列174px的可用文字宽度使部分词恰好落在行尾。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"材料列较宽，数字列保持等宽，事项与材料仍能按行对应；三条数据的行高与r2A相同。","problems":"时限表头仍逐字换行，合并表头仍有三行。事项名称比r2A更窄，却没有减少材料行数或改善材料中的跨行断词，整体收益有限。","cause":"第2、3列仍各为48px；第1列从89px缩至83px，增加给第4列的6px不足以改变当前材料的换行格局。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"事项列较宽，名称在每行容纳更多文字；两种时限仍等宽，数字容易比较。","problems":"较长事项名称依然换行，且“登记”和“许可”被拆开；材料列更窄，出现更多不自然的词语跨行。时限子表头仍逐字换行，表头依然高。","cause":"第1列107px扣除21px后不足以容纳最长事项名称；第4列缩至162px，材料更容易在词中断行；第2、3列各45px，容不下两个汉字。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-headers","widths":[89,52,52,166],"change":"以r2A为基础，将两种时限各加宽至52px，使“法定”和“承诺”各自有望完整占一行，并给合并表头更多空间；从材料列取回8px，观察材料断词是否可以接受。"},{"name":"materials-priority","widths":[83,52,52,172],"change":"以r2B为基础保留较宽的材料列，同时让两个时限子表头各有31px文字宽度；比较较窄事项列和较宽材料列之间的阅读效果。"},{"name":"intact-names","widths":[113,52,52,142],"change":"给事项列92px文字空间，尝试让最长事项名称保持一行，同时保持两个时限子表头完整；以更窄的材料列检验名称完整性是否值得增加材料换行。"}]}
